title: OpenHarmony Toggle
scope: 框架行为参考；开关尺寸和网页视觉为同风格补全。
note: 开关通过 isOn 表达状态，通过 onChange 响应切换。
scopeEn: Framework behavior reference; switch dimensions and web styling extend the shared visual language.
noteEn: Switch state is expressed through isOn, with onChange handling toggles.

title: OpenHarmony Radio
scope: 采用圆形勾选视觉与浏览器原生单选键盘行为，非 ArkUI 组件绑定。
note: 同组单选互斥；API 12 起默认选中图案由圆点变为勾。
scopeEn: Circular checkmark styling with native browser radio keyboard behavior, not an ArkUI binding.
noteEn: Radio options in a group are exclusive. Since API 12, the default selected mark is a tick rather than a dot.

title: OpenHarmony Checkbox
scope: 勾选与禁用状态参考框架，网页增加可访问的混合选择状态。
note: 多选表达独立选择状态；配合分组选择与取消。
scopeEn: Checked and disabled states follow the framework; the web version adds an accessible mixed state.
noteEn: Checkboxes represent independent choices, with group selection and deselection.

title: OpenHarmony Progress
scope: 框架形态参考，具体进度数值和文档处理过程为本地演示。
note: 进度以 value / total 表达；线形与环形用于不同空间和任务反馈。
scopeEn: Framework form reference; progress values and document processing are local simulations.
noteEn: Progress uses value / total; linear and circular forms suit different spaces and tasks.
